effect.description: Supports Skills which create Minions, causing your Skills which can target Minions to prioritise targeting Minions from the Supported Skill before your other Minions where possible, as well as causing them to always be considered Detonatable.

effect.name: Guatelitzi's Ablation
effect.description: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills Sacrifice a portion of your life on use. While Offering spikes from Supported Skills persist, you are periodically granted a Power Charge. When spikes from Supported Skills die, Regenerate a percentage of your maximum Life and Mana per second based on the duration the Offering persisted.

effect.name: Sacrificial Offering
effect.description: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills Sacrifice a portion of your life on use, but deal much more damage and have more powerful Buffs in return.

effect.name: Unleash
effect.description: Supports Repeatable Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when cast, each causing the Spell to Repeat. Cannot support skills with a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.
effect.excludeExpr: UsedByProxy OR Triggered OR Persistent OR Instant OR Channel OR Cooldown OR ComboStacking OR (HasSeals AND NOT SupportedByUnleash)

effect.name: Zarokh's Revolt
effect.description: Supports Repeatable Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time and giving them a moderate Cooldown. The Seals are broken when cast, each causing the Spell to Repeat. Cannot support skills which already have a Cooldown or gain seals.
effect.excludeExpr: UsedByProxy OR Triggered OR Persistent OR Instant OR Channel OR ComboStacking OR (HasSeals AND NOT SupportedByUnleash)

effect.name: Expand
effect.description: Supports Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when cast, increasing area of effect. Cannot support Channelling Skills or Skills with a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.
effect.excludeExpr: UsedByProxy OR Triggered OR Persistent OR Instant OR Channel OR Cooldown OR ComboStacking OR (HasSeals AND NOT SupportedByExpand)

effect.name: Scouring Flame
effect.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but the skill to gain a Runic Ward cost.

effect.name: Searing Flame I
effect.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but its Hits to deal less damage.

effect.name: Searing Flame II
effect.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but its Hits to deal less damage.

effect.name: Second Wind I
effect.description: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

effect.name: Second Wind II
effect.description: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

effect.name: Second Wind III
effect.description: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown and causing them to recover your Life when a Skill is used and goes on cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

effect.name: Uhtred's Constellation
effect.description: Supports non-instant skills which have a cooldown, granting them two additional cooldown uses and more damage per different skill with a cooldown you have used recently.

effect.name: Selfless Remnants
effect.description: Supports Skills that generate Remnants, causing those Remnants to affect Allies in your Presence when collected instead of you.

effect.name: Seraph's Heart
effect.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, providing a chance for enemies to calculate their Hits as though your Resistances were 90% while the skill is active.

effect.name: Shock
effect.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Shock.

effect.name: Shock Conduction
effect.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to also Shock nearby enemies when you Shock an enemy.

effect.name: Shock Conduction II
effect.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to also Shock nearby enemies when you Shock an enemy. Always Shocks enemies which are Drenched.

effect.name: Shock Siphon
effect.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Energy Shield when it kills a Shocked enemy.

effect.name: Shocking Leap
effect.description: Supports Skills that leap into the air and deal damage, causing them to create Shocked Ground the first time they Critically Hit an enemy.

effect.name: Short Fuse I
effect.description: Supports Skills which Detonate after some amount of time has elapsed, shortening the time before Detonation.

effect.name: Short Fuse II
effect.description: Supports Skills which Detonate after some amount of time has elapsed, massively shortening the time before Detonation at the cost of Damage.

effect.name: Skittering Stone I
effect.description: Supports Skills which create shatterable earthen objects. After killing enough Enemies in range of these objects, they will shatter, releasing skittering stone Minions.

effect.name: Skittering Stone II
effect.description: Supports Skills which create shatterable earthen objects. After killing enough Enemies in range of these objects, they will shatter, releasing skittering stone Minions.

effect.name: Soul Drain
effect.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Mana when it Culls an enemy.

effect.name: Spar
effect.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills are more capable of Stunning Enemies the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.

effect.name: Spectral Volley
effect.description: Supports Bow or Spear Projectile Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills deal lower damage initially, but generate Spectral Projectiles, which deal more damage when they fire. Spectral Projectiles linger and will fire a short duration after no new Spectral Projectiles have been created. Cannot support Channelling Skills, Leaping skills, or skills which rain Projectiles from above.
effect.requireExpr: (Bow AND Attack) OR ((Spear AND Projectile) AND Attack)
effect.excludeExpr: UsedByProxy OR Triggered OR Persistent OR Rain OR Channel OR Jumping

effect.name: Spell Cascade
effect.description: Supports Cascadable Spells, causing them to Cascade to either side of the target area, along a randomly chosen axis.

effect.name: Spell Echo
effect.description: Supports Cascadable Spells you use yourself. Supported Spells Echo.

effect.name: Trickster's Shard
effect.description: Supports non-instant Spells you cast yourself. Supported Spells will Trigger Fragment Self, creating a Fractured Mimic which will cast that Spell if you get enough of them.
effect.excludeExpr: UsedByProxy OR Triggered OR Persistent OR Instant

effect.name: Zarokh's Refrain
effect.description: Supports Cascadable Spells you cast yourself. Supported Spells Echo thrice, but are given a Cooldown. Cannot support skills which already have a Cooldown.
effect.excludeExpr: (Cooldown AND NOT SupportedByZarokh) OR UsedByProxy OR Triggered OR Persistent OR Channel OR Attack

effect.name: Tul's Avalanche
effect.description: Supports Cascadable Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them when you Block, The Seals are broken when used, each making the Spell Echo. Cannot support skills with a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.
effect.excludeExpr: UsedByProxy OR Triggered OR Persistent OR (HasSeals AND NOT SupportedByTulsAvalanche)

gems.name: Static Shocks
gems.tagString: Spell, AoE, Trigger, Sustained, Lightning, Duration

effect.name: Static Shocks
effect.description: Supports Skills which can Hit enemies. Shocking an enemy with Hits from Supported Skills Triggers Static Shocks, causing that enemy to become a source of Lightning damage sending pulses towards nearby enemies.

effect.name: Steadfast I
effect.description: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, granting you higher Stun Threshold while Channelling them.

effect.name: Steadfast II
effect.description: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, granting you higher Stun Threshold and Ailment Threshold  while Channelling them.

effect.name: Stoicism I
effect.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills steadily gain more Damage, up to a cap. This Damage bonus is reset if you Dodge Roll or use a Travel Skill.
effect.excludeExpr: UsedByProxy OR Triggered OR Persistent OR Spell

effect.name: Stoicism II
effect.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills steadily gain more Damage, up to a cap. This Damage bonus is reset if you Dodge Roll or use a Travel Skill.
effect.excludeExpr: UsedByProxy OR Triggered OR Persistent OR Spell

effect.name: Stomping Ground
effect.description: Supports Travel skills, causing your footsteps to crack the earth and emit damaging shockwaves while using the skill.

effect.name: Stormchain
effect.description: Supports Projectile Skills and Skills which can Chain. Supported Skills always Chain when initially Hitting a Shocked Enemy, but cannot themselves inflict Shock. Does not support Skills which cannot Chain.

effect.name: Stormfire
effect.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies. Enemies Shocked by Supported Skills take a percentage of damage from Ignite as Lightning damage as well as Fire damage.

effect.name: Streamlined Rounds
effect.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills. Supported Skills have significantly higher Attack speed and bolt capacity, but deal less damage and have longer reload time.

effect.name: Strong Hearted
effect.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Shock applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.

effect.name: Stun I
effect.description: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun more quickly.

effect.name: Stun II
effect.description: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun more quickly.

effect.name: Stun III
effect.description: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun significantly more quickly, at the cost of Damage.

effect.name: Styrn's Mountain
effect.description: Supports Skills that Raise your Shield causing your other melee skills to deal more damage if you block.

effect.name: Supercritical
effect.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage with Critical Hits but have less Critical Hit chance.

effect.name: Swift Affliction I
effect.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing it to deal more non-Ailment damage over time but have a shorter duration.
effect.requireExpr: Damage OR Attack OR DamageOverTime OR CrossbowAmmoSkill

effect.name: Swift Affliction II
effect.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing it to deal more non-Ailment damage over time but have a shorter duration.
effect.requireExpr: Damage OR Attack OR DamageOverTime OR CrossbowAmmoSkill

effect.name: Swift Affliction III
effect.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing effects with a duration of one second or less to deal more non-Ailment damage over time.
effect.requireExpr: Damage OR Attack OR DamageOverTime OR CrossbowAmmoSkill

effect.name: Syzygy
effect.description: Supports Slam Skills you use yourself. Hits from Supported Skills are considered Crushing Blows against Enemies which are both Ignited and Fully Armour Broken. Hits with Supported Skills that Heavily Stun Ignited and Fully Armour Broken Enemies will Intimidate them.

effect.name: Tacati's Ire
effect.description: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Poison inflicted with Supported Skills deals Damage faster the higher your Rage.

effect.name: Tear
effect.description: Supports Melee Attacks you use or Trigger yourself. On-Kill effects caused by Killing Blows with Supported Skills on Bleeding enemies have a chance to occur twice.

effect.name: Thornskin I
effect.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Thorns Damage while the Supported Skill is active.

effect.name: Thornskin II
effect.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Thorns Damage while the Supported Skill is active.

effect.name: Thrill of the Kill
effect.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Culling a Shocked enemy with Supported Skills infuses all of your Attacks with Lightning damage for a short time.

effect.name: Thrill of the Kill II
effect.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Culling a Shocked enemy with Supported Skills infuses all of your Attacks with Lightning damage and grants an increased chance to Shock for a short time.

effect.name: Tireless
effect.description: Supports Warcry Skills. Attacks Empowered by Supported Skills have a chance not to lower the Empowerment count of Supported Skills when they are used.

effect.name: Cirel's Cultivation
effect.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing you from having more than one of that Totem but granting significant benefits for Supported Totems based how many allied Totems are near them. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

effect.name: Splinter Totem I
effect.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing having more than one active Totem but causing that Totem to splinter into smaller versions of itself after it uses an Attack or Spell, with each Totem becoming less effective. Each splintered Totem can further splinter, up to a maximum. Does not Support Skills used by Minions. Only one Totem can be splintering at a time.

effect.name: Splinter Totem II
effect.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing having more than one active Totem but causing that Totem to splinter into smaller versions of itself after it uses an Attack or Spell, with each Totem becoming less effective. Each splintered Totem can further splinter, up to a maximum. Does not Support Skills used by Minions. Only one Totem can be splintering at a time.

effect.name: Heightened Charges
effect.description: Supports any Skill that Consumes Charges, granting a chance for benefits of that Consumption to be doubled.

effect.name: Uhtred's Augury
effect.description: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them additional levels provided exactly two other supports are used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

effect.name: Uhtred's Exodus
effect.description: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them many additional levels provided no other supports are used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

effect.name: Uhtred's Omen
effect.description: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them additional levels provided exactly one other support is used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

effect.name: Uhtred's Rite
effect.description: Supports skills with Cooldowns, causing them to grant Overflowing Chalice when used. Supported skills deal more damage during the effect of your Life Flask and have increased Mana Cost Efficiency during the effect of your Mana Flask.

effect.name: Undermine
effect.description: Supports Attack Skills. Supported Skills Consume Maim on hit, Breaking a percentage of the Maimed target's Armour in doing so. Supported Skills cannot themselves inflict Maim.

effect.name: Unerring Power
effect.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. When Supported Attacks are Empowered, they have significantly lowered cost and raised Accuracy.

effect.name: Untouchable
effect.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, you gain increased Evasion Rating, with the increase scaling higher the longer the Attack time of the supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.
effect.excludeExpr: Channel OR UsedByProxy OR Triggered OR Persistent

effect.name: Upwelling I
effect.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing your Minions to deal increased Damage while you are not on full Mana while the Supported Skill is active.

effect.name: Upwelling II
effect.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing your Minions to deal increased Damage while you are not on full Mana while the Supported Skill is active.

effect.name: Urgent Totems I
effect.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly.

effect.name: Urgent Totems II
effect.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly.

effect.name: Urgent Totems III
effect.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly. Totems created by Supported Skills have increased Attack and Cast Speed.

effect.name: Vanguard I
effect.description: Supports Shield Skills, causing you to gain Guard on Stunning Enemies with the Supported Skill.

effect.name: Vanguard II
effect.description: Supports Shield Skills, causing you to gain Guard on Stunning Enemies with the Supported Skill.

effect.name: Varashta's Blessing
effect.description: Supports any Skill that can deal damage, causing it to deal more damage for each different Command Skill you have used in the past few seconds. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.
effect.requireExpr: Attack OR Damage OR DegenOnlySpellDamage OR CrossbowSkill OR CrossbowAmmoSkill

effect.name: Verglas
effect.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which can Hit Enemies. Supported Skills Gain a percentage of their Damage as Cold Damage when you destroy Ice Crystals.
effect.requireExpr: Damage OR Attack OR CrossbowSkill OR CrossbowAmmoSkill

effect.name: Vitality I
effect.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain Life Regeneration while the Skill is active.

effect.name: Vitality II
effect.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain Life Regeneration while the Skill is active.

effect.name: Volatility
effect.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills grant Volatility on Critical Hit.
effect.requireExpr: Attack OR Damage OR CrossbowSkill OR CrossbowAmmoSkill

gems.name: Volcanic Eruption
gems.tagString: Attack, AoE, Melee, Strike, Projectile, Trigger, Fire

effect.name: Volcanic Eruption
effect.description: Supports Melee Strike Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills trigger Volcanic Eruption on Hit against Ignited Enemies.

effect.name: Volt
effect.description: Supports Projectile Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain Voltaic Charge as you move, up to a maximum. When used, Supported Skills expend that Charge to gain extra Lightning Damage.

effect.name: Vruun's Aftermath
effect.description: Supports Warcries, causing them to destroy Ice Crystals and Ice Fragments. Supported Skills empower additional Attacks if they destroy enough Ice Crystals and Ice Fragments.

effect.name: Warm Blooded
effect.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Freeze applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.

effect.name: Wildfire
effect.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, Spreading Ignites it inflicts to nearby enemies after a delay.

effect.name: Wind Wave
effect.description: Supports any skill that you can use, triggering a blast of wind that Knocks Back enemies if you are Stunned while using it.

effect.name: Window of Opportunity I
effect.description: Supports Channelling skills that have special effects if released with Perfect Timing, causing them to deal much more damage if released with Perfect Timing but reducing the Perfect Timing window.

effect.name: Window of Opportunity II
effect.description: Supports Channelling skills that have special effects if released with Perfect Timing, causing them to deal much more damage and grant Perfect Deflection if released with Perfect Timing but reducing the Perfect Timing window.

effect.name: Withering Touch
effect.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Wither enemies on Hit.

effect.name: Xibaqua's Rending
effect.description: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing Corpses in the area you land to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.

effect.name: Zenith I
effect.description: Supports Spell Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage while you are above 90% of your Maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

effect.name: Zenith II
effect.description: Supports Spell Skills. Supported Skills have increased Mana cost Efficiency and deal more damage while you are above 90% of your maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

effect.name: Zerphi's Infamy
effect.description: Supports Attacks and Warcries you use yourself. Supported Skills gain a Glory requirement, and build Glory when you spend Life on Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage and have significantly\n increased area of effect.
